use bytes::Bytes;

pub const HANDLE_SIZE: i64 = 64;

pub type job_id_t = u64;

pub type status_code_t = u32;

pub type local_handle_t = Bytes;

/// Metadata-only projection; the terminal opaque body remains in caller storage.
pub type local_handle_tMetadata = onc_rpc_xdr::OpaqueLength<{ HANDLE_SIZE as usize }>;

/// Alternate argument representation retaining multiple owners for one terminal opaque body.
pub type local_handle_tSegments = onc_rpc_xdr::OpaqueSegments<{ HANDLE_SIZE as usize }>;
